scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojna Evam Ganga Gaaye Mahila Dairy Yojana
description:
The Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojna Evam Ganga Gaaye Mahila Dairy Yojana is a significant welfare scheme launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh in India.

This scheme was inaugurated on 20th November 2019.

The primary objective of this initiative is to empower women in rural areas by promoting dairy farming as a sustainable livelihood option.

The scheme aims to enhance the socio-economic status of women through the establishment of dairy cooperatives.

It specifically targets women who are members of self-help groups or cooperatives.

The initiative also focuses on improving the quality of milk production and increasing the income of women dairy farmers.

Under this scheme, the government provides financial assistance for the purchase of high-yielding dairy cattle.

Women beneficiaries can receive a subsidy of up to 50 percent of the cost of the dairy cattle.

The maximum subsidy amount can go up to INR 30,000 per beneficiary.

This financial support is aimed at making dairy farming more accessible to women.

The scheme also includes training programs for women to enhance their skills in dairy management.

These training programs cover aspects such as animal husbandry, veterinary care, and milk processing.

The government has set a target to establish at least 1,000 dairy cooperatives under this scheme.

Each cooperative is expected to consist of a minimum of 20 women members.

The scheme is designed to promote collective farming and dairy production.

Eligible beneficiaries must be at least 18 years old and not more than 55 years old.

The income limit for eligibility is set at INR 1 lakh per annum for rural households.

Women must also have a basic understanding of dairy farming or be willing to undergo training.

The application process for the scheme involves several steps.

Interested women must first approach the local cooperative society or the district dairy development office.

They need to fill out the application form provided by these offices.

Required documents include proof of identity, proof of residence, and income certificate.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities.

After approval, beneficiaries will be notified regarding the subsidy amount.

The disbursement of the subsidy is typically made directly to the bank account of the beneficiary.

The scheme operates on a continuous basis with no specific deadline for applications.

However, the government encourages timely applications to ensure prompt processing.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Uttar Pradesh.

The department is responsible for overseeing the implementation and monitoring of the scheme.

For any queries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the district animal husbandry officer.

Each district has a dedicated helpline for women seeking information about the scheme.

The scheme also aims to promote the use of modern technology in dairy farming.

This includes the use of artificial insemination and veterinary services.

The government has partnered with various NGOs to facilitate training and support for women.

The initiative is expected to benefit over 50,000 women in its initial phase.

The scheme also aligns with the National Dairy Plan of India.

This national plan aims to increase milk production and improve the livelihoods of dairy farmers.

The Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojna Evam Ganga Gaaye Mahila Dairy Yojana is part of the broader efforts to empower women in agriculture.

The government has allocated INR 100 crores for the implementation of this scheme in the first year.

Monitoring and evaluation of the scheme will be conducted annually.

The scheme is expected to create a significant impact on rural economies.

It aims to reduce poverty levels among women in rural areas.

The initiative also encourages women to take leadership roles in their communities.

The government is committed to ensuring that women have equal access to resources and opportunities.

The scheme is part of the larger framework of women's empowerment initiatives in Uttar Pradesh.

It complements other schemes such as the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana and the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act.

The Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojna Evam Ganga Gaaye Mahila Dairy Yojana is a step towards achieving gender equality in agriculture.

The government aims to create a supportive environment for women in dairy farming.

This includes providing access to credit and financial services.

The scheme also promotes the establishment of milk processing units.

These units will be managed by women cooperatives.

The government encourages the formation of women-led dairy cooperatives to enhance collective bargaining power.

The initiative is expected to lead to an increase in milk production in the state.

This, in turn, will contribute to the overall economic development of Uttar Pradesh.

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to rural development and women's empowerment.

It reflects the recognition of the critical role women play in agriculture and food security.

The Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojna Evam Ganga Gaaye Mahila Dairy Yojana is a model for similar initiatives across India.

The success of the scheme will be measured through various indicators such as increased milk yield and income levels.

The government aims to document success stories to inspire other women to participate in dairy farming.

The scheme is expected to foster a sense of community among women dairy farmers.

It encourages knowledge sharing and collaboration among members of dairy cooperatives.

The Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojna Evam Ganga Gaaye Mahila Dairy Yojana is a significant step towards sustainable development in rural Uttar Pradesh.
